runtime_templates: checked-in SQL; no Jinja2, sqlglot or private repository dependency

bindings.__COHORT__: all/hot/cold in eligible engagement branch only

intentional_changes: Retail entities, metadata content, channel labels, JSON paths, child registry path parsing and account offer categories replace the original domain.
Preference normalization uses lowercasing and regex replacement of non-alphanumeric/non-underscore runs.
Latest-non-null channel windows use an explicit full-partition frame, with channel payload tie breakers.
Point-in-time windows compare dates inclusively, including report-day events with nonmidnight timestamps.
Monthly quantity keeps hidden engagement/catalog group keys and includes them in surrogate-key ordering.
Equal-time secondary observations and receipts choose the greatest non-null reported units; assessment lookup chooses the greatest non-null assessment key.
DuckDB syntax replaces Spark syntax; permissive casts use TRY_CAST.
Generated physical source IDs are separate from business and registry keys.
Hot/cold predicate is added to the eligible engagement family; monthly purchase quantity remains a control.
Equal-valued effective-unit candidates prefer parent capacity, then engagement units, then receipt units, retaining the leading coalesced-value ranking.
Equal-time parent state observations use customer_status descending, null last; inactive wins over active when timestamps tie.
Nullable household joins use IS NOT DISTINCT FROM, preserving null and bag semantics while enabling DuckDB hash joins.

Monthly engagement effective-unit contributions use DECIMAL(28,10) before SUM, then round half away from zero before integer conversion. The explicit ten-digit fractional precision prevents floating-point reduction order from changing integer results at half-unit boundaries.
preserved: 96 materialized roles and dependency graph, including logical metadata barrier
Shared intermediates, join families, aggregation and bag semantics
Business engagement versus registration-key ranking grains
remaining_validation: Conflicting equal-time current metadata arrivals beyond the generated schedules
